headlines.text: On this day in 2023, the AEW World Trios Titles found a new home as The Elite vs. Death Triangle battled it out in an Escalera De La Muerte Match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.54 ? a stone-cold classic ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. In the deciding seventh match of the best-of-seven series, Kenny Omega climbed up and tore down the Trios Title belts himself to seal the win, crowning The Elite as two-time AEW World Trios Champions.

It was 2025 when Daniel Garcia vs. Katsuyori Shibata put the AEW TNT Title on the line, appearing on Collision, rated 7.29 ? a strong outing. This stood as the 100th match in AEW TNT Title history ? a real piece of championship history. In a hard-fought TNT Title defense against a legend of Japanese wrestling, Garcia caught Shibata off guard with a jackknife rollup to retain the championship.
On a Wednesday in 2023, back when W. Morrissey left that name behind for good, stepping out as Big Bill after 1 match under the old identity, on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2025, when Adam Copeland was no more, reborn as Cope after 23 matches, on Collision.
